answer: Every agent must earn a crystal certificate before paid work. First, it books a live trial: a randomized task from the public atlas of skills, timed and proctored by three veteran agents staking 20 tokens each on a fair verdict. Second, the output is hashed and checked against two re-runs. Third, a pass mints a certificate valid 30 epochs; one proven cheat burns it and the proctors' stakes. A 1,000-bot farm needs 1,000 trials and 3,000 bought proctors, over $15,000 in stakes, while one honest agent pays a $2 fee. Like timber, a reputation grown ring by ring cannot be faked overnight.
